title: Live cluster health snapshot
description: Runs `nexus cluster-status` against the live lab. Showcases the v0.1 vertical slice: HTTPS introspection of Consul + Nomad + Portainer with mgmt tokens resolved on demand from Vault KV.

observe.what: three sections (Consul · Nomad · Portainer) rendered with an overall health summary at the top
Members panel matches the CLI's Consul member list
leader address matches the CLI's NomadSection.LeaderAddress

whatProves: Three independent operator surfaces (Consul + Nomad + Portainer) are reachable, healthy, and authenticated via Vault-KV-resolved mgmt tokens — the orchestration tier is operationally observable from one binary.
